detail.longDescription: Hey HN! My name is Julia, I am co-founder of mylasertools set of free tools for laser cutting and engraving! Recently we build a programming language for designing files for laser cutting and cnc! It's syntax maybe familiar to OpenSCAD Users, but it takes in consideration laser cutting operations, kerf, materials and assembly! Check out models we created with it and a playground! https://kerfscript.mylasertools.com/models/
